parent_objective: implement no-training action-divergent outcome-pressure source constructor and focused tests
blocked_by: M1423 admits implementation only after defining a new evidence axis and gates

public_gates: M1424 must implement a no-training source constructor only
M1424 must include focused tests for candidate selection history-positive counting and contract flags
M1424 must not run full source smoke outcome interventions train run PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run full source smoke
do not run outcome interventions beyond focused fixtures
do not count zero-current as history-positive
do not count action divergence as outcome evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements the no-training constructor designed in M1423 without claiming outcome evidence yet
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure implementation only; no full source smoke outcome intervention training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export paper-level or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if implementation changes actor inputs
stop if constructor cannot separate action-critical from outcome-critical rows
stop if history-positive accounting includes zero-current controls
stop if full source smoke is run before a separate manifest
fallback_plan: fall back to a simpler candidate/export-only smoke if relocation is too large for one milestone
route to design audit if implementation exposes infeasible assumptions
admit source smoke only after tests pass

admission_evidence: M1423 defines the new evidence axis and gates
M1421 had many action-critical rows but no warmup-history-positive outcome rows
blocked_shortcuts: do not run full source smoke
do not run outcome interventions except focused tests
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up source-smoke manifest if implementation passes

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1424 is infrastructure and must not claim history necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1423 design; no full source run in M1424.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If implementation cannot preserve the accounting contract, record it and audit before source smoke.
allowed_claims: no promotion corpus export training PPO private-holdout high-fidelity paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A no-training source constructor can separate action-critical from outcome-critical history variants and emit source-diverse outcome-pressure rows for later evaluation.
success_criteria: focused tests cover history-positive versus reset/zero-current accounting
focused tests cover output summary schema and contract flags
implementation chooses next route without full source smoke outcome intervention training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: history-positive accounting counts reset or zero-current controls
implementation runs full source smoke or routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or claim expansion
